scope: Editor-style grammar rules (subject-verb agreement, articles, prepositions, Vietnamese classifiers) with false-positive guards

implementation.subjectVerb: he/she/it + base verb (74 common verbs) -> third-person form derived by rule (have->has, be->is, do->does, go->goes, -s/-es/-ies)
implementation.numberAgreement: plural technical subjects (reports/documents/users/systems/...) + is -> are; singular subject + are -> is
implementation.articles: a/an chosen by vowel sound with exception lists (a university/user/one, an hour/honest/heir)
implementation.prepositions: depend of->depend on, responsible of->responsible for, interested on->interested in, discuss/explain about, capable to, concentrate in, in Monday->on Monday; replacement keeps capitalization
implementation.vietnameseClassifiers: những/các + cái + person noun -> drop cái; những/các + một/mỗi/từng -> drop the quantifier; một + những/các -> một
implementation.languageGuard: paragraphs containing Vietnamese characters skip English-only rules (subject-verb/number/articles/prepositions) to avoid cross-language false positives
implementation.repeatedWords: Unicode lookaround boundaries replace \b so 'ng' inside 'Những người' is not a repeat; Vietnamese paragraphs skip the repeated-word rule to avoid reduplicative false positives (song song, thành phần phần mềm, Phân vùng Vùng)
implementation.sentenceCase: only capitalizes after . ! ? inside a paragraph, requires a following letter, keeps the abbreviation guard
